topic: The hours your business is closed are the hours homeowners deal with the house.

slides.subtitle: (the one that runs after you clock off)
slides.scene: A service van parked on a driveway at dusk, rear doors shut, tools stowed, the last daylight going out of the sky behind it. The house beyond has one lit window.
A kitchen at night lit only by an open fridge, water pooled across the tiles in front of an appliance pulled out from the cabinets.
slides.annotation: that is when people notice things
bullets: evenings and weekends are when people are home
that is when the fault gets discovered
your office is closed for all of it

slides.scene: A homeowner hand holds a phone in a dark hallway, the screen a plain pale blue rectangle with no readable content, a torch beam on wet skirting board beyond.
slides.annotation: the list is right there on the screen
bullets: they work down the search results
the first response usually takes it
nobody is loyal at eleven at night

slides.annotation: not a voicemail, an actual answer
bullets: it answers on the first ring at any hour

it books into the morning you have free

slides.scene: A white calendar grid on a garage wall with three slots filled by solid Scaile blue blocks and the rest left open, a mug of coffee on the bench below it.
slides.annotation: it fills the diary, you run the day

slides.annotation: the day is already planned before you start it

slides.scene: The ScaileAI field technician stands beside a large white door standing open in a garage wall, a band of Scaile blue light falling through the doorway across the floor.
slides.ctaPromise: comment it and I will send the build plan

caption:
Your business is open roughly a third of the week. The house your customer lives in is open all of it.

Things fail in the evening because that is when people are home to notice them. The AC gives out after dinner. The water heater goes on a Saturday. Somebody finds damp under the sink on a Sunday afternoon.

At that moment they pick up a phone and start working down a list. They are not loyal to anybody at eleven at night. They just want somebody to answer.

By Monday morning that job belongs to whoever did.

The fix is not working longer hours. Nobody sustains that and it is a bad trade anyway. It is having something awake that answers properly, asks what you would ask, and puts the job into a morning you actually have free.

You still decide which work you take and when you work. It just stops the middle of the night being a dead zone.

If you want to see how this would run on your numbers, book a twenty minute walkthrough at scaileai.com.
